game.core.rules.readable.title: Reading a Character Sheet
game.core.rules.readable.summary: A character sheet gathers the character's available identity, abilities, defenses, features, resources, actions, and equipment into one readable view.

blocks.heading: Available state
blocks.body: Only sections supported by the character's current recorded state are shown. Missing sections are not replaced with assumed values.

blocks.heading: Authority
blocks.body: The readable sheet explains current results. Catalog mechanics remain authoritative for calculations and state changes.

examples.title: Incomplete character
examples.body: A character without spellcasting state has no spellcasting section; the rest of the available sheet remains readable.

citations.locator: Character Creation > Step 3: Ability Scores > Generate Your Scores > Standard Array, PDF p. 21
